notes: TOI-1203 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)

TOI-1203 b: nothing measured to show (no dayside temperature or archive spectrum; TESS sectors 90, 99, 100 show no 5-sigma dip within 3 sigma (14 min) of its ephemeris (best 82 ± 17 ppm over 14 transits))
TOI-1203 e: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
